notes.title: Notice of Release Date Change
notes.notes: [p]We have an important announcement for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]We have decided to change the release date of the Steam version of "Hungry Meem" from June 19, 2025 (Thursday) JST to July 31, 2025 (Thursday) JST.[/p][p]While development of the game itself is progressing smoothly, there remain some challenges as we work on adjustments to ensure smooth gameplay on PC environments.[/p][p]For this reason, we have made the decision to postpone the release of the Steam version.[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to those who have been eagerly awaiting the Steam version's release.[/p][p][/p][p]Regarding the price, we will share further details later, but for now, we plan to set it at the same price as the product that will be released earlier.[/p][p]The entire team is striving to deliver the game in its best possible state as quickly as we can, and we would appreciate your patience in the meantime.[/p][p][/p][p]Drecom Co., Ltd.[/p][p][/p]
